training: Use only the 15 training rows and six native CPU readings per row in experiments/results/cpp20-v8-training.json from workmeter #62. Equal weight per program/scale; median of all six in ns, including unstable rows, without filtering or replacement. Three diagnostic readings per feature, same artifacts and fixed layout for both cohorts.
method: Apply experiments/branch_load_interaction.py fit/predict to these features in order. Per-feature median of 3 counts per training case, normalized by training maximum (zero columns have zero coefficient), response-scaled nonnegative least squares without intercept minimizing equally weighted squared relative errors, scipy.optimize.nnls. Coefficients in ns per unit rounded to nearest 1e-9; predicted nanoseconds from integer upward-rounded dot product. No new features, fold screening, calibration, ranking-based choices or model adjustments.
source: Linux x86-64, fixed ASLR and CPU, matching static ELF/stdin/expected stdout. Full time_features -bpred (14-bit gshare) and exact packaged v8 meter with x86-64-v2 CPUID on one pass. Separate optimized L1D meter pass with -probe_l1d, same CPUID profile and address layout. Require identical production instruction and typed REP counters across diagnostic passes; runtime checks enforce single uninterrupted image/thread, no replay/missing/unsupported REP, full oracle agreement. Reject corrupt or incomplete measurements; never pick more favorable repeats.
cache: Cold 32 KiB virtual demand data cache, 64-byte lines, 64 sets, eight-way exact LRU, write-allocate. Decoded read-then-write application operands including supported REP. No hardware counter. Retain refs, lines, misses, skipped, rep for each repetition; report skipped/(refs+skipped) separately. No imputation or fitted correction for skipped accesses.
release: Freeze both sets of coefficients and all case-by-repetition predictions with SHA256 before any new holdout native readings. No prior holdout label is an input.
gates: Primary candidate absolute prediction error <=20% of case median of six native brackets on every repetition in all 3 external programs. Report baseline under the same rule. All native readings >=20 ms and (max-min)/median <=10%; each model input counter (max-min)/median <=0.1% with all-zero treated as stable. Report unavailable/failed gates separately, preserve each outcome.
boundaries: P = median of three sealed candidate predictions. Against nominal b_ms the offline candidate predicts AC when P<=b_ms*1e6, else TLE. Collect actual native outcomes blinded on fixed 80% and 120% of P as well as predeclared 80%/120% of case native median N (3 repetitions each at distinct thresholds) and ordinary v8 live outcomes on the N bounds. Round positive nominal ms to nearest via floor(x+0.5), minimum 1. Actual accelerated-memory online clock unavailable. No role in judging or policy promotion.
